# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** head and front of the enterprise  <sub>[v2 c14 P5](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a sonsy, matronly, and kindly woman. She is known for sitting at her kitchen window keeping a sharp eye on everything passing along the road.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a highly capable, energetic, and outspoken woman who prides herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor. Though extremely officious, gossipy, and prone to giving unsolicited advice, she possesses a deeply good and generous heart. She is very strict with children, extremely observant, and holds strong opinions on politics, religion, and church affairs. Despite her blunt and sharp-tongued nature, she is a loyal friend and a gentle nurse to those in need.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c21 P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v3 c13 P55](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0055), [v3 c18 P20](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0020)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde spent forty-five years living at Lynde's Hollow near Green Gables with her meek husband, Thomas. She was an indispensable force in Avonlea, actively running church societies, participating in local politics, and managing her home and neighbors' affairs. When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert adopted Anne Shirley, Rachel initially voiced sharp criticism regarding Anne's looks, sparking a temporary quarrel, though she quickly accepted Anne's apology and grew fond of her. At the local Exhibition, she won first prize for her butter and cheese. When her husband Thomas fell ill and passed away, it was revealed that their farm was mortgaged to support their youngest son; consequently, the farm was sold. Following her husband's death, Rachel accepted Marilla's invitation to move into Green Gables, residing in the spare room. At Green Gables, she helped manage the household, assisted in raising the twins Davy and Dora, and remained deeply involved in community and church matters.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v3 c5 P8](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0008), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)_
